summary: Non-Hydro entries in Midway's Thunder-branded arcade racing family, covering off-road, four-wheel, and snowmobile racing.

entries.title: Offroad Thunder

emulation.emulator: MAME / original hardware / Dolphin / PCSX2 / xemu
emulation.notes: Use arcade preservation for the primary route; console compilation emulation is fallback.

primary.why: Offroad Thunder is sourced as an arcade off-road racing game and later appeared in Midway Arcade Treasures 3 for Xbox, PlayStation 2, and GameCube. The arcade version is the original, direct route.
primary.how_to_play: Play on original arcade hardware or a supported arcade preservation setup; use Midway Arcade Treasures 3 on console as the fallback.

all_releases.fidelity: Original Midway Quicksilver II arcade release.

all_releases.reason: skip: compilation fallback, no sourced content advantage over arcade.
skip: compilation fallback, no sourced content advantage over arcade.
skip: compilation fallback, no sourced content advantage over arcade.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: No sourced content difference between arcade and compilation routes.

entries.remaster_caveats: Midway Arcade Treasures 3 is a compilation fallback, not a remaster.

entries.title: 4 Wheel Thunder

emulation.notes: Use high-resolution Dreamcast emulation for the recommended route.

primary.why: 4 Wheel Thunder is sourced as a Dreamcast-only racing game in Midway's Thunder series, with monster trucks, ATVs, buggies, 12 tracks, shortcuts, championship, arcade, practice, and multiplayer modes.
primary.how_to_play: Play the Dreamcast release in Flycast at high internal resolution or on original hardware.

all_releases.reason: primary: only release route and complete game.

entries.remaster_caveats: No remaster or later port is sourced.

entries.title: Arctic Thunder

emulation.notes: Use Ultimate arcade where available; Xbox or PS2 are fallback home routes.

primary.why: Arctic Thunder released in arcades and on PlayStation 2 and Xbox with added content; a later Ultimate Arctic Thunder arcade update added some home-version content back into the arcade game. The updated arcade route best preserves the cabinet presentation while adding sourced extra content.
primary.how_to_play: Play Ultimate Arctic Thunder on original arcade hardware or a supported preservation setup; use Xbox emulation/hardware as the fallback home version.

all_releases.fidelity: Original Quantum3D Graphite arcade release with cabinet fans and seat vibration.
all_releases.reason: skip: original cabinet route, but the Ultimate update adds sourced extra content.

all_releases.fidelity: Home console version with added content.
all_releases.reason: skip: lower-fidelity home route; Ultimate arcade adds some home-version content while preserving cabinet presentation.

all_releases.fidelity: Home console version with added content.
all_releases.reason: skip: useful fallback, but not compatible with Xbox 360 and no sourced unique content is specified beyond the home-added content family.

all_releases.fidelity: Updated arcade version adding some content introduced in the home versions.
all_releases.reason: primary: best sourced balance of arcade fidelity and added content.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: Home versions added content, while Ultimate Arctic Thunder adds some of that content back to arcade; public sources do not enumerate a remaining home-exclusive checklist, so the updated arcade route is the conservative primary.

entries.remaster_caveats: Dreamcast port was planned but canceled; Xbox release is not compatible with Xbox 360.
